thread.title: Nasdaq’s 1.6% intraday tumble takes tech-heavy stock-market gauge to roughly 2-week low

author: Stocks News Feed
title: Nasdaq’s 1.6% intraday tumble takes tech-heavy stock-market gauge to roughly 2-week low
text:
The Nasdaq Composite Index early Monday was the worst performer among the three main U.S. benchmarks, with its drop putting the index on track to close at its lowest level in about two weeks. The Nasdaq
 COMP, -2.82%
 was down 1.7% at 7,280. A close there would mark the technology and internet-related index’s lowest level since Oct. 30 when it finished at 7,161.65, according to FactSet data. A sharp decline in shares of Apple Inc.
 AAPL, -5.17%
 was weighing on the broader market, including the market-capitalization S&P 500
 SPX, -1.61%
 and the price-weighted Dow Jones Industrial Average
 DJIA, -1.59%
